text:
sarah: FYI opened PR #4827 to change the infer_pool module's kms_key input from list(string) to string. Tests pass locally but gitops plan in prod-repo is erroring during the reconcile.

jen_ops: got the same plan error on the CI run: `Error: Incorrect attribute value type` coming from module.infer_pool.kms_key. plan fails early. :frowning:

eli: can you paste the plan stderr?

jen_ops: sure, snippet from the reconcile job logs:
```
Error: Incorrect attribute value type

  on modules/infer_pool/variables.tf line 22, in variable "kms_key":
  22:   type = list(string)

Inappropriate value for attribute "kms_key": element 0: string required.
```

ravi: ah, upstream provider bump changed how KMS ARNs are passed from the shared-kms module (it now emits a string instead of a single-element list). module variable type mismatch.

samir: we should avoid forcing a breaking tf variable type change across repos. options: (1) revert PR and do deprecation cycle, (2) make the variable type `any` and coerce/normalize inside the module, or (3) add a small migration step in gitops that converts state before reconcile.

sarah: I intentionally made the module stricter to reduce confusion, but yeah didn't think about cross-repo state shape. We need the least disruptive path for prod.

eli: option 2 is safest short-term: change var to `any` and in module do something like:
```
locals {
  kms_key_normalized = (
    can(length(var.kms_key)) ? (length(var.kms_key) > 0 ? var.kms_key[0] : "") : var.kms_key
  )
}
```
Then use local.kms_key_normalized everywhere. That accepts old list or new string. Add a deprecation note in README and a follow-up ticket to flip type after one release cycle.

jen_ops: +1. Also add an acceptance test in the module CI that runs two scenarios (old list, new string) so we don't regress.

ravi: for prod gitops, we should also patch the reconcile pipeline so it doesn't attempt a destructive replace if the only diff is the variable shape. Maybe gate the apply with a manual approval when types change.

samir: for the state migration path (if we later flip to strict string), we'll need a small one-off TF state transform. Example jq flow I used before:
```
terraform state pull > state.json
jq '.resources |= map(if .module == "module.infer_pool" and .type=="aws_kms_key" then (.instances |= map(.attributes.kms_key |= (if type=="array" then .[0] else . end))) else . end)' state.json > state-fixed.json
terraform state push state-fixed.json
```
Only to be used with backups.

sarah: ok let's do option 2 now. I'll update PR to switch var type to `any` and add locals + tests + README note. I'll also add a tiny gate in gitops that flags if module schema changed (helm/terraform-diff check) so on next rollout we don't auto-apply.

deploy-bot: reconcile job for repo=prod-infra failed on 2025-06-14T15:39:25Z: terraform plan error in modules/infer_pool. See CI run: https://ci.redwood.dev/runs/32911 (logs attached)

eli: assigning me to CI tests for module, I'll add the two scenario runs and a unit test that validates normalization.

jen_ops: I'll add the gitops gate ticket: INFRA-912, manual-approval-on-schema-change.

samir: once PR is merged we should do a canary reconcile on staging cluster first. I'll schedule a window tomorrow morning to watch metrics (scheduling latency, pod boot failures) in case provider alias misbehaves.

sarah: thanks team. Action items: sarah update PR (#4827) to use `any` + normals + README; eli add CI scenarios; jen_ops add INFRA-912; samir run canary reconcile and monitor. Target: merge + staging canary by EOD tomorrow. :eyes: :shipit:
